subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which session activity contract and Control UI scope should own the compact active-run progress surface requested here?
rationale: The requested UI needs state beyond current `status` and `hasActiveRun`, and related open issues and PRs propose different Gateway API, session-state, and presentation boundaries.

options.title: Make the activity contract canonical first
options.body: Define the Gateway activity/attention state, reconnect semantics, and child/subagent rollup, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of that contract.

options.title: Adopt a narrowed open PR
options.body: Pick an existing candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96672 or a smaller UI subset only after trimming it to the accepted API and proof boundary.

options.title: Defer to coarse status for now
options.body: Keep the current coarse Control UI status until maintainers are ready to own broader session activity semantics.

recommendation.title: Make the activity contract canonical first
recommendation.body: Define the Gateway activity/attention state, reconnect semantics, and child/subagent rollup, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is already attached to the broader Gateway session activity contract and has relevant gateway/protocol history for the public API decision.
